name: Hotel Hagerhof
beschreibung: The Hotel Hagerhof is located in the municipality of Thiersee in Tirol. It is situated in the immediate vicinity of the Thierseer See with a view of the surrounding mountains. The atmosphere is rural and quiet. In summer, hiking trails in the Alpen are available, in winter several ski areas in the region. The amenities include a restaurant, a wellness area, and rooms with lake view. Guests can expect accommodation here with a connection to nature and outdoor activities.
